summary.en: A fintech-focused fund-of-funds announced under the FinTech Industry Alliance (launched 19 Feb 2025), convened by CTBC, E.Sun, KGI and Cathay financial holdings, with the investment working circle led by KGI Financial Holdings / CDIB Capital. Initial scale NT$6.0B–7.5B from financial holdings, targeting NT$10B+ with National Development Fund participation; at least 40% stays in Taiwan and it prioritises FinTech (blockchain, AI, big data, digital payments, financial inclusion). Targeted to launch around Q1 of the following year.

strategy.thesis: Greater Southeast Asia's leading early-stage VC and accelerator, organised around three themes — AI, Blockchain, and Southeast Asia ('ABS'). Its blockchain/fintech pillar (since first crypto investment in 2018) backs Web3 financial-infrastructure builders, with regional banking partners and fintech-investor access.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to AppWorks Accelerator (twice-yearly batches) at appworks.tw/accelerator, or pitch AppWorks Funds directly.

summary.en: Founded in 2009, AppWorks is one of Greater Southeast Asia's largest early-stage VC firms and accelerators, with US$212M AUM after closing its US$150M Fund III (vs US$50M Fund II) in 2021. Its strategy centres on three themes — AI, Blockchain, Southeast Asia ('ABS') — making blockchain/fintech a primary pillar; since its first crypto investment in 2018 it has backed Web3 financial-infrastructure builders including Blocto, XREX, Dapper Labs/Flow and Animoca Brands.
summary.local: 成立於2009年，AppWorks 是大東南亞最大的早期創投與加速器之一。2021年完成1.5億美元的第三號基金(第二號基金為5,000萬美元)後，管理資產達2.12億美元。投資策略圍繞三大主題——AI、區塊鏈、東南亞(ABS)——區塊鏈/金融科技為其核心主軸；自2018年首筆加密投資以來，已投資 Blocto、XREX、Dapper Labs/Flow 與 Animoca Brands 等 Web3 金融基礎建設企業。

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's first fintech-focused hub/accelerator, empowered by the FSC and TFSR and operated by the Institute for Information Industry (III); supports fintech startups across AI, wealth management, blockchain, ID/eKYC/eAML, InsurTech, RegTech and payments, with a Regulation Clinic, Digital Sandbox, Funding Matchmaking Platform and Global Connection.

program.eligibility: Fintech startups and tech startups applying AI, wealth management, blockchain, ID identification, InsurTech, eKYC, eAML, RegTech and payments (not limited).

summary.en: Taiwan's first fintech-focused co-working hub and accelerator, empowered by the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) and TFSR and operated by the Institute for Information Industry (III). It supports fintech startups across AI, wealth management, blockchain, ID/eKYC/eAML, InsurTech, RegTech and payments, offering subsidised resident packages, a Regulation Clinic, Digital Sandbox, Global Connection and a Funding Matchmaking Platform that connects startups with VCs (CDIB, Paragon, Sunsino, Top Taiwan VC, etc.) and the National Development Fund.
summary.local: 台灣首座以金融科技為主軸的共享空間與加速器，由金管會(FSC)與台灣金融服務業聯合總會(TFSR)指導、資策會(III)營運。支持涵蓋 AI、財富管理、區塊鏈、身分識別/eKYC/eAML、保險科技、法遵科技與支付的金融科技新創，提供補貼進駐方案、法遵諮詢、數位沙盒、國際連結，以及媒合創投(中華開發、金石、華陽、華威等)與國發基金的募資媒合平台。
